issues.problem: The MCP server cannot be hosted on GitHub Pages (static hosting) — a process host is required (Docker/Workers/local).
CORS: the browser demo against the remote /mcp requires an explicit ALLOWED_ORIGINS (secure-default: 403).
Locally the browser demo calls /mcp through the vite proxy; in production (no running server) it automatically falls back to the local engine.
pnpm lint (oxlint) reports 0 warnings; the CI note about Node 20 deprecation in actions/checkout@v4 is cosmetic.
OG preview is cached by social networks (X/LinkedIn/Telegram): after a deploy the first share may show the old preview — reset via validators.

get_articles failed: dev.to → 403 from the worker (200 from a normal IP). Fix in code: UA header + fallback to the committed metrics.json snapshot. Verified by experiment (source: live, 5 articles). Live confirmation — after deploy.

Public /mcp without rate limiting. Implemented in code ([[ratelimits]] 300/60 + CHAT 30/60), but EMPIRICALLY NOT ENFORCED on the current plan: limit() always returns success. Likely requires Workers Paid.
simulate_architecture: llm_saturation did not affect non-LLM models but claimed 'LLM generation dominates'. Fixed: honest 'no LLM stage' finding + test.

Article draft: the 'I know Kubernetes' example contradicted the live analyze_stack (matched:false, no evidence in the project stack). Resolved: the article uses Kubernetes only as an honest counterexample — consistent with matched:false.
Agent counter (KV calls:*) — eventually consistent and approximate (get+put is not atomic). Acceptable for the 'queries today' demo metric.

Lab page #/lab: JSON projections (src/data/lab/*.json) mirror the markdown logs (EXPERIMENTS_LOG.md, AGENT_DIARY.md, KNOWN_ISSUES.md). Drift is risky: the page and MCP tools read the JSON. Guard: tests/lab.test.ts validates structure/integrity; log edits must sync the JSON in the same commit.

Custom Python LSP cannot register in Zed (settings.json only overrides KNOWN LSPs). WONTFIX on Zed — full editor LSP support requires a Rust+WASM zed_extension_api wrapper. Mitigation: LspClient (basedpyright subprocess) → 3 MCP tools.
LanceDB API surface changes between minor versions — the pin must be verified against the exact installed version before every bump.
Default memory retrieval is a substring stub (self-assessed 4/10) — weak for semantic recall; Mem0 server recommended for production-grade retrieval.
Repository name 'gemma_agent' is historical — refers to the project, not Google DeepMind Gemma. Must be explained to avoid confusion.
